visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with reddish-brown hair tied in a ponytail sits cross-legged on green grass behind a small beige folding table. She wears a white spaghetti strap top and smiles brightly at the camera, gesturing with her hands. The table is covered with several white and blue product boxes and electronic devices. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of her holding a beige handheld fan. She demonstrates its folding mechanism and points to the circular fan head. The background shows a park setting with trees and a white soccer ball on the grass. (3) A small child in a white shirt appears briefly on the right side of the frame, holding a purple fan. The woman continues to demonstrate the beige fan, showing a purple strap attached to it. (4) The woman puts on a purple strap around her neck which holds a small purple fan resting on her chest. She gives a thumbs-up and a peace sign. (5) The woman holds up a white square power bank, demonstrating its magnetic side for an Apple Watch. A hand enters the frame from the left to hold a black version of the power bank. (6) Close-up shots of the power bank's ports and built-in cables (Lightning and USB-C). (7) The video concludes with a shot of all the products—fans and power banks—arranged on a car dashboard against a background of parked cars and trees.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A cheerful female voice introduces a group buy session over an upbeat, synthetic pop background music track with a steady 4/4 electronic beat. The vocal is high in arousal and positive in valence. (2) As the speaker transitions to describing the portable fan, a light 'pop' SFX is heard. The BGM remains consistent in volume as a background bed. (3) A male voice joins the female speaker, providing technical details about the fan's speed and cooling chip. His tone is informative and slightly lower in pitch. (4) The female speaker resumes, excitedly demonstrating the power bank. The audio track features frequent hard cuts between sentences to maintain a fast, social-media-friendly pace. (5) Mechanical clicking sounds are faintly audible as products are handled. The female voice remains the primary focus until the end, concluding with a call to action over the fading electronic track.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Feature Demo 1 -> Product Feature Demo 2 -> Product Variation Overview -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote and facilitate a group purchase of LaPo branded portable fans and power banks by highlighting their innovative features (cooling chip, magnetic charging) and portability in a relatable outdoor lifestyle setting.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct verbal recommendation, on-screen display of brand boxes, and explicit call to 'down the order' (下單) for a group buy.
